fields.title: Data security incident: message map

keyMessages.message: We detected unauthorized access quickly and contained it.
proofPoints: Detected Tuesday morning; server isolated within the hour.
Plants and shipping were not interrupted.

keyMessages.message: We will tell customers what we know when we know it.
proofPoints: A dedicated customer line opens Thursday.

hardQuestions.question: Was customer data stolen?
hardQuestions.answer: We have not yet determined what was accessed. We will tell customers directly once we know.

hardQuestions.question: Why did it take hours to tell the public?
hardQuestions.answer: We confirmed the facts first and issued a statement the same afternoon.

doNotSay: Do not say "no customer data was affected" until forensics confirms it.
Do not speculate about who is responsible.
fields.approvedBy: Approved: Communications Director and General Counsel
